title: Exact bank optimization, weighted matching, and E8 verification
body:
This PR contributes exact bank optimization, weighted donor-rank matching, and independent E8 verification.

The latest signed commit `c548d26fc96e7abb40574c811de4ca7a3bb79f99` adds a [chart-sensitive dirty-endpoint checker](https://github.com/lydakis/integer-mult-bounds/tree/c548d26fc96e7abb40574c811de4ca7a3bb79f99/research/e8-dirty-chart-audit). Ordinary scalar identity can miss cross-helper dirt when a prewhitening map does not commute with distinct entrance charts. The checker keeps those charts separate and requires a concrete exact Gaussian witness before calling a formal mismatch a counterexample.

The source-pinned original PR419 word and our entrance-956 extension both expose this gap in the proposed independent residual-bank interface. The admitted PR416+956 control passes in both orientations. This is a scoped verification contribution: **no new κ record is claimed**, and a different coupled-bank construction with its own proof is not ruled out. The [proof](https://github.com/lydakis/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c548d26fc96e7abb40574c811de4ca7a3bb79f99/research/e8-dirty-chart-audit/PROOF.md) identifies the precise inherited contract and exact witnesses.

All four focused regression tests pass, including the valid control, original/extended failures, required normalization chronology, and a formal mismatch that correctly remains inconclusive. Ody independently reproduced the Gaussian witnesses and reviewed the portable package. All 21 staged files matched the frozen source manifest byte for byte. Python 3.11+ and the standard library suffice:

```sh
python3 -B research/e8-dirty-chart-audit/verify.py
```

Repository CI for the new head is pending. The completed local checker tests are separate from the historical repository CI results below. No new workflow or executor was introduced.

The earlier signed commit `615a38a62361e0d47542b3fc122f3a18bc6968e2` adds [research/e8-exact-bank-optimizer](https://github.com/lydakis/integer-mult-bounds/tree/615a38a62361e0d47542b3fc122f3a18bc6968e2/research/e8-exact-bank-optimizer). For width73 and residual ranks {4,5,7,8,9}, it constructs optimal bank patterns with integer arithmetic, proves necessary-and-sufficient conditions for attaining the bank-cost lower bound, and computes the minimum replica count. The proof includes the retained fallback charge for every exponent between zero and one. No floating optimizer or dependency installation is needed.

This is a positive optimization algorithm and proof contribution, **not a new multiplication κ claim**. It directly reproduces the optimal bank costs of the pinned PR404, PR409 and PR410 inventories. The minimum packing replication is distinguished from the architecture's replication constraint: PR404 permits a four-replica packing algebraically, while its existing expander still requires a multiple of eight. The API preserves that constraint explicitly.

Independent validation compares the algorithm with an exhaustive pattern-reachability oracle over **16,875 inventories**. All four focused tests pass, including pinned source witnesses, compressed multiplicities above 10^40, architecture boundaries, invalid inputs and certificate mutations. Ody independently reviewed the mathematics, implementation and scope. All 18 staged package blobs match the frozen manifest byte for byte; original source fixture line endings are preserved.

```sh
python3 -B research/e8-exact-bank-optimizer/verify.py
python3 -B research/e8-exact-bank-optimizer/bank_optimizer.py \
  research/e8-exact-bank-optimizer/inputs/example-inventory.json \
  --replica-multiple 8 --output /path/to/new-patterns.json
```

The example constructs PR410's 1,471 banks with 743 rank-one pads at 16 replicas. Changed multiplication suppliers still require their separate local, phase, ownership, finite-invoice and outer admission. This optimizer does not establish those conditional interfaces or a Lean theorem. Credits, immutable source pins and proof are included. Prepared for George Lydakis with substantial OpenAI Codex and Ody assistance.

All **56 exact-head repository CI jobs passed** at `615a38a62361e0d47542b3fc122f3a18bc6968e2`: [research and formal suite, 52 jobs](https://github.com/lydakis/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38131014238), [terminal elimination, 2 jobs](https://github.com/lydakis/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38131014248), and [recycled registers, 2 jobs](https://github.com/lydakis/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38131014221). These existing workflows are separate from the optimizer's completed local exhaustive verification; no new executor or workflow was introduced.

## Earlier contributions retained

The earlier signed commit `b1372b602ff22e796b73211a7bacc4acd9afa8f3` added independent verification of the retimed nine-stage E8 complex component. The weighted-matching exponent below remains unchanged.

The new [self-contained verification package](https://github.com/lydakis/integer-mult-bounds/tree/b1372b602ff22e796b73211a7bacc4acd9afa8f3/research/e8-retimed-component-verification) closes the certificate-specific finite checks explicitly left open in [PR384](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/384) at `fd81a16a`: emitter/splice, both dirty scalar words, private-work lifetimes, changed Clifford frames/transitions and actual local/global finite costs. It freshly reproduces all eight original [PR377](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/377) stages, then verifies [PR378](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/378)'s substituted word with separately measured and frozen regression pins. Final admission rejects missing pins. All original sources and every negative control are retained.

**Verified conditional complex saving: `999632926176283/10^18 = 0.000999632926176283`.** PR384 already proposes this number. The contribution is the missing component evidence, with full credit to its construction and retiming authors. It is not a new numerical record and does not admit PR384's combined multiplication exponent or PR382's bit-side obligations.

All nine scientific subprocess stages returned zero, including the eight-stage original regression. The candidate checks cover 948 frames, 3,122 exact Clifford transitions, all 72 local invocations, both independent rational moment engines, adjacent-grid rejection, 20 splice/global controls, five structural controls and nine omitted-bridge controls. The rebuilt invoice has local bound `7040031186072`, per-cover cost `558450079948471`, and physical row coefficient `15445 < 20161`; every retained strict guard passes. Original source hashes remain unchanged.

The bounded run took 195.92 seconds. After every scientific stage passed, the original wrapper hit Python's JSON digit limit while reading a 9,634-digit integer. Its failure record is preserved. A separately reviewed receipt-only step completed the remaining assertions and hash checks without replaying a child process. The portable wrapper includes that parsing fix and relative paths; its input-only check passes all 219 package input hashes. All 220 committed files were checked byte for byte against the working inputs. The full scientific run used the preserved original adapter; no additional full portable-wrapper replay is claimed here.


Exact-head fork CI at `b1372b602ff22e796b73211a7bacc4acd9afa8f3` completed successfully: [research and formal suite](https://github.com/lydakis/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38119298363), [terminal elimination](https://github.com/lydakis/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38119298374), and [recycled registers](https://github.com/lydakis/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38119298362). These repository workflows complement the separately recorded local component verification; they are not a new full run of the added portable component wrapper.

Reproduce with Python 3.11+ and its standard library, using a fresh external output directory:

```sh
python3 -B research/e8-retimed-component-verification/verify.py --check-inputs
python3 -B research/e8-retimed-component-verification/verify.py --output /path/to/new/output
```

The original licenses, authorship, source pins, logs, receipts, original wrapper failure and receipt-only recovery are included. The local E8, Clifford/compiler, common-grid, precision/recovery and analytic interfaces remain conditional assumptions. No Lean build or new bit-side admission is claimed. Independent execution and review were prepared for George Lydakis with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including Ody.

---

The `research/gen5b-weighted-matching/` package rebuilds compensated reuse **after producer endpoint descent**, choosing donors by their actual final-frame rank. It composes that word with all PR299 kernels and PR300's second scalar descent, followed by freshly screened early restorations and terminal sinks.

**Conditional κ = 46942230864663 / 62500000000000000 = 0.000751075693834608.**

This is **0.00249968% above this PR's previous weighted-matching checkpoint** (`03acc26f9624ce15c4149f927b7b9aeb0de301b8`) and **0.156885% above independently reproduced PR299 at `5f6bd3fbc0e6796dd31263cef1f06dc968186f64`** (`0.000749899215319498`).

This is the reproducible weighted-matching checkpoint that later contributions build on. [PR307](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/307) explicitly reuses this weighted virtual word and producer while re-deriving stronger kernel selections; [PR308](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/308) carries those selections through additional reorder stages. Subsequent proposals now advertise higher bounds. The contribution here is the donor-rank matching method, its scoped proof, portable producer, and independently replayed composition. The incorporated PR300 second-descent transformation remains pinned to `fd516176fd068e4fa7af14b40cd878ce8c305296`.

The exact post-descent graph has 65,920 eligible donor edges. Rebuilding matching admits **1,728 reuse pairs instead of 1,726**, and donor-rank weighting chooses **878 rank-21 donors instead of 706**. For each fixed exponent between zero and one, higher donor rank increases the donor-only splice benefit. A transversal-matroid argument supports the weighted rule on this fixed graph; Hopcroft-Karp independently checks maximum cardinality. This does not assert optimality over producer frames, module designs, later transforms or the full finite construction.

| Quantity | PR299 | This package |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Reuse pairs | 1726 | 1728 |
| Final independent dirty registers | 15427 | 15425 |
| Literal stock, 60 replicas | 1229750 | 1229735 |
| Kernel entries | 1720 | 1720 |
| Early restorations | 440 | 440 |
| Terminal sinks | 7 | 7 |

All 904 initial scalar retimings and 220 target groups are rebound to the weighted word. All 1,720 kernel entries are mapped through logical roles and rechecked. PR300's **89 post-kernel retimings** are bound by logical role, identical scalar occurrence census and exact old-frame basis. Its unchanged native descent transformer checks spans, paths, both reflected ledgers, endpoints, COPY lifetimes and scalar projection; its unchanged `rebind_descent2` charges the entire delta. Restorations and sinks are freshly screened afterwards.

The second descent adds 65 local paid calls (93,539 → 93,604), with unchanged rank mass, 721,418 scalar ADD events and 724,938 unit ADD events. Its full additional cost is retained. The complete invoice includes 913 endpoint charts, conservative normalizer 815, 905,876,840,400 selector calls, primitive coefficient **90,322,316,339,049,601**, and a 98-bit signed payload bound. Cleanup and arbitrary dirty old-value return remain paid. Both exact moment engines, all 47 outer constraints and adjacent-grid exclusion are recomputed.

All eighteen inherited mathematical/checker cores listed in `SECOND-DESCENT-PROVENANCE.json` remain unchanged from the preceding public checkpoint. `SOURCE.json` records original PR299 differences and the pinned PR300 contribution. The final physical word SHA-256 is `6a723cdd5285a7b2085d3f612af3f2fc6e7e997ba943243aac936e0ff4735a3e`; package manifest is `a74e82e07777be4df1dc47a8b646029a30641027c9e0c1764e45d774b26630d9`.

Reproduction requires Python 3.11+, SymPy 1.14.0 and new output directories:

```sh
python -m pip install -r research/gen5b-weighted-matching/requirements.txt
python -B research/gen5b-weighted-matching/verify.py \
  --output /tmp/gen5b-weighted-verification
python -B research/gen5b-weighted-matching/gen5bit/producer/regenerate.py \
  --work /tmp/gen5b-weighted-regeneration
```

The verifier freshly executes all twelve stages, rejects pin-recording mode, runs retained mutation and omitted-stage controls, and rechecks every source hash at completion. A new control invokes the unchanged restoration transformer on the actual pre-second-descent word and requires rejection at its input-word hash guard. The producer command rebuilds all five pinned virtual files from module data, endpoint descent and weighted matching, with all local F2 and defining-integer-decoder columns checked. Gzip members are compared after decompression. The producer and its five outputs are unchanged from the previous fully verified checkpoint. Neither command consumes cached PASS receipts.

The preceding `8268f385` maintenance update only clarified documentation: `MATCHING-PROOF.md` explicitly labels the `03acc26` bound as historical and links the current second-descent result. Its manifest entry is updated. All other 155 package inputs, including every numerical input, selection and checker, are unchanged from the independently verified scientific checkpoint `10b40041d4ab8a6610083e95bc571aee3468bca2`. Historical provenance and replay receipts are preserved.

Historical weighted-matching checkpoint: signed head `8268f385147549636f085b8a6d3422a268286c46`. Native package integrity passes all 156 input hashes. All four fork workflows completed successfully on that historical head, **59/59 jobs passed**:

- [Weighted matching](https://github.com/lydakis/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38096039688): both complete twelve-stage replays, on Python 3.11 and 3.13, and full five-file producer regeneration passed (3/3).
- [Full repository research and formal suite](https://github.com/lydakis/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38096039675): 52/52, including joint-dual checks on all three Python versions.
- [Terminal elimination](https://github.com/lydakis/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38096039713): 2/2.
- [Recycled registers](https://github.com/lydakis/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38096039588): 2/2.

At that checkpoint, GitHub reported the PR ready for review and mergeable, with eight upstream workflows requiring maintainer approval. These historical CI results do not certify the new component package.

The branch also integrates upstream `12a4934d15006e8c10f9b2264f13f8f341be802b`. The sole merge conflict was `.gitattributes`; both sets of exact-byte preservation rules are retained. Follow-up `7163446` refreshes the historical joint-dual bindings for the reviewed upstream root `Makefile` and `README.md` and regenerates only the dependent certificate/validation hashes. Complete native `make verify-joint` passed, including both producer words, exact profiles, 47 constraints, seven margins, all 16 regression controls and the independent arithmetic audit. Every numerical and proof field remains unchanged. All 56 fork CI jobs on that preceding maintenance head passed.

Independent local replay of the scientific package completed all twelve stages in 261.80 seconds. Fresh imported-checkpoint verification also passed: all nine gen4 stages and all eight source527 stages. Previous Linux runs reproduced all five weighted producer files. Current-head CI is reported separately above.

The inherited all-size compiler, common chart, restored-row, selector, routing, prime-supply, precision/recovery, complex-correctness and analytic interfaces remain assumptions. This is a conditional finite construction, not an unconditional multiplication theorem, a new Lean proof or a practical runtime benchmark.

Prepared for George Lydakis with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including Ody's matching/composition research and coordinated independent integration/review. Compensated reuse itself and the other mechanisms are inherited. Original PR299 and PR300 notices and licenses are preserved. Earlier PR275 packages remain reproducible historical checkpoints; that package supplies the weighted-matching result reported here.
